# @sharadox/vitest-configuration-web-library

> Shared Vitest configs: package self-imports resolve to source, standard test-file patterns, optional React/happy-dom, 100% coverage thresholds.

- `defineLibraryTest({ root: new URL("./", import.meta.url), environment?: "node" | "happy-dom", react?: boolean, coverage?: { branches?: number, ... } })` from `@sharadox/vitest-configuration-web-library/library-test` (code in source/).
- `defineApplicationTest({ root })` from `…/application-test` (code in src/, happy-dom + React default, src/app/** excluded from coverage).
- Tests: source/**/?(*-)unit-test.{ts,tsx}; benchmarks: ?(*-)benchmark-test; test-fixture/ skipped.
- Coverage: v8, thresholds 100 for statements/branches/functions/lines; run `vitest run --coverage`.
- Peer deps: vitest, @vitest/coverage-v8 (and happy-dom for browser tests).
- License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
